messages:
Alex R (oncall): handing off for overnight — INC-3987 still active. embeddings-prod p99 latency spike started ~20:10 UTC, alerts noisy earlier but we're still seeing degraded throughput. I'm primary until 04:00 UTC. Priya is secondary.

Alex R (oncall): quick summary: affected service = embeddings-api -> worker pool v3. Symptoms: p95 ok, p99 elevated ~2-3x usual, some 503s when queue backs up. Dashboard shows ~12% error rate for embeddings calls and ~7 customers seeing >30% request slowdowns.

Priya K: ack. any customer-facing mitigations already applied?

Alex R (oncall): yes — started two mitigations at 20:25 UTC: 1) reduced batch_size from 16 -> 8 for v3 pool, 2) disabled prefetch on the busiest shard to reduce head-of-line latency. Also added routing rule to send non-critical tenants to embeddings-small model to preserve capacity.

Marcos S: logs + quick checks: run this to see queue backlog (use k8s job logs):
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/embeddings-worker-v3 --since=30m | grep "enqueue_count" -n | tail -n 50
```
Marcos S: tail shows steady enqueue bursts coinciding with p99 spikes, worker GC seems fine, no obvious OOMs.

Lina: i've pulled support ticket for ACME (high-volume). CS reports slower search indexing jobs since 20:15 UTC. they are on dedicated capacity but hit fallback routing earlier. notified account mgr.

Priya K: what's the plan if reduced batch_size doesn't hold? can we scale the v3 pool up? cost/ops constraints?

Alex R (oncall): scaling up is limited tonight — reserved capacity at nominal. Next step is temporary burst to spare-hosts in eu-west region (can flip on for 30m). If we do that, we should also enable graceful draining on lower-priority tenants.

Alex R (oncall): to trigger burst: run `opsctl capacity bump --pool embeddings-v3 --hosts 4 --region eu-west --ttl 30m` (needs ops creds). I'm not doing that right now unless secondary signs off.

Priya K: can do if you want me to. i'm near a laptop in ~10m. also recommend adjusting KV cache TTL for embeddings prefix to 10m to avoid re-computation spike (runbook step 4).

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-3987 updated by Alex R (oncall) — status: investigating — priority: P1 — impacted customers: 7 — linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-latency

Marcos S: small watchlist items: 1) nv_peer_errors in infra logs (rare) — tracking but not a blocker yet. 2) slightly elevated request retries from gateway -> embeddings-proxy.

Lina: customer note: ACME ticket #5557 — asking for ETA, told them we'll have update in 30m.

Alex R (oncall): runbook pointers: follow embeddings-latency runbook -> sections: triage, mitigations, rollback. key commands listed under "Ops Mitigation". I pasted the critical snippet: 
```yaml
# ops mitigation snippet
- reduce_batch_size: 8
- disable_prefetch: true
- route_noncritical: embeddings-small
```

Priya K: noted. i'll be secondary and can escalate to ops for burst if metrics don't improve by 21:10 UTC. please add me to the PD escalation if you trigger burt/ops.

Alex R (oncall): action items for overnight: 
- Priya: standby for scaling bump (21:10 UTC threshold)
- Marcos: keep watching worker logs and report any nv_peer_errors spike
- Lina: keep CS updated every 30m for impacted customers (ACME top priority)
- Alex (me): monitor dashboards, will push small config changes and watch for regression.

Priya K: will do. any coverage gaps?

Alex R (oncall): small gap 03:00-04:00 UTC — I need to hand off before that window for a hard stop. if incident persists when I hand off at 03:50, Priya will become primary and I'll notify on shift start. otherwise I'll mark resolved before then.

Marcos S: FYI i'll add a short dashboard tile for enqueue_rate and avg_batch_time to the incident view (5m).

Lina: noted, i'll update ACME with the 30m ETA.

Alex R (oncall): last notes: severity currently P1 due to multiple paying customers affected. no broad downtime. Escalation path -> ops-oncall -> infra lead (Marcos) if NV errors > 5% in 15m. keeping thread pinned. :thumbsup:

Priya K: ack, thanks. standby.

pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to Priya K (secondary) — if no ack within 15m, escalate to ops-oncall."
